Jal Shakti Vibhag Anni Recruitment 2026 – Para Cook & Para Helper Posts

Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag has released a recruitment notice for the engagement of Para Cook and Para Helper under Jal Shakti Division Anni, District Kullu. Eligible and interested candidates can submit their applications in the prescribed format within the given dates.

📲 Join Himexam WhatsApp Channel

The applications will be accepted from 22 September 2026 to 09 October 2026. Candidates should carefully check the eligibility conditions, required documents, selection process and other terms before applying.

Jal Shakti Vibhag Anni Recruitment 2026 – Overview

Recruitment Department Jal Shakti Vibhag, Himachal Pradesh
Division Jal Shakti Division Anni
District Kullu, Himachal Pradesh
Post Names Para Cook and Para Helper
Application Mode Offline
Application Start Date 22 September 2026
Last Date 09 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM
Selection Merit/Eligibility Evaluation and Skill Test

Jal Shakti Vibhag Anni Vacancy 2026

Post UR SC OBC EWS ST
Para Cook 01 00 00 00 00
Para Helper 01 00 00 00 00

Total Posts: 02

Para Cook Eligibility Criteria

  • The candidate should have passed the Matriculation examination from a school/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh.
  • The condition of passing Class 10th from a Himachali school is not applicable to a Bonafide Himachali.
  • The candidate should possess a Degree/Diploma in any trade from a Government-approved Hotel Management Institute, Institute of Hotel Management or Food Production Institute.
  • Alternatively, the candidate should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in cooking/catering from any Government or private institution.
  • The candidate must submit a separate affidavit stating that no family member is employed in any Government/PSU/Board job.

Para Helper Eligibility Criteria

  • The candidate should have passed the Matriculation examination from a Board/University recognised by the Government of Himachal Pradesh.
  • The candidate must submit a separate affidavit stating that no family member is employed in any Government/PSU/Board job.

Age Limit

The prescribed age limit for both Para Cook and Para Helper is:

18 to 45 years

Honorarium / Monthly Payment

Post Honorarium
Para Cook ₹9,000 per month
Para Helper ₹5,500 per month

General Eligibility Conditions

As mentioned in the recruitment notice, candidates should fulfil the following conditions:

  • Citizen of India.
  • Bonafide Himachali.
  • Having a sound mind.
  • No family member of the candidate should be in any Government/PSU/Board job.
  • The candidate should not have been involved in any act of criminal nature.
  • The candidate should be medically fit to perform the duties.
  • The candidate should be a permanent resident of the areas under Jal Shakti Circle, Kullu, Himachal Pradesh.

Selection Process

The selection/evaluation criteria mentioned in the notification include the following:

Selection Criteria Marks
Percentage of marks obtained, calculated out of 10 5
BPL family having annual income as prescribed from time to time 1
Experience in the related field 2
Skill Test for engagement of Para Cook and Para Helper 2

Total: 10 Marks

The initial eligibility will be decided on the basis of marks obtained, relevant work experience and the category of the candidate. A separate communication regarding the skill/physical test will be made through newspaper publicity.

Documents Required

Candidates are required to attach attested/self-attested copies of the relevant documents with the application form. The notice lists the following documents:

  1. Matriculation examination certificate from a school/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh, wherever applicable.
  2. Degree/Diploma in any trade from a Government-approved Hotel Management Institute/Institute of Hotel Management/Food Production Institute, or minimum 5 years’ cooking/catering experience certificate.
  3. Bonafide Himachali Certificate.
  4. Certificate/affidavit regarding no family member being employed in any Government/PSU/Board job.
  5. Character Certificate.
  6. Medical Fitness Certificate.
  7. Declaration/certificate regarding no involvement in any criminal activity.
  8. BPL certificate not older than six months, if applicable.
  9. Experience Certificate in the related field, if applicable.

How to Apply for Jal Shakti Vibhag Anni Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates have to apply through the prescribed application form. The application should be submitted with the required attested/self-attested documents.

  1. Obtain the prescribed application form.
  2. Fill in all required details carefully.
  3. Attach the required documents and certificates.
  4. Mention the name of the post applied for on the envelope.
  5. Submit the application to the office of the Executive Engineer, Jal Shakti Division Anni, District Kullu, Himachal Pradesh.
  6. Make sure that the application reaches the concerned office by 09 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

Applications received after the last date or found incomplete may be rejected. The department will not be responsible for delays in receipt of applications.

Application Submission Date

Application Start Date: 22 September 2026

Last Date to Submit Application: 09 October 2026

Last Time: 5:00 PM

Application Mode: Offline

Working Hours and Service Conditions

  • The selected incumbent will be paid the prescribed monthly honorarium.
  • The working hours will be 6 hours per day.
  • A quarterly self-reporting format will be submitted by the Para Cook and Para Helper.
  • A consolidated report will be prepared at the end of every financial year for certification of satisfactory work and conduct.
  • Unsatisfactory performance may result in termination of the engagement as per the prescribed procedure.

Where to Get the Application Form?

The application form can be obtained from the offices of the Assistant Engineer, Jal Shakti Sub-Division, Anni, Shwadd, Dalash, Nither & Nirmand on any working day.

The recruitment advertisement and prescribed application form are also stated to be available on the official Jal Shakti Division Anni website.
